subject.title: feat(clients): show live plan checklists in web, iOS, and Android chat

question: Should this PR be narrowed to the plan-client feature before review continues, or should the unrelated cron and 1Password behavior changes intentionally remain bundled?
rationale: The extra changes cross compatibility and credential-handling boundaries, so accepting them as part of this feature requires explicit ownership and review intent rather than an automated assumption.

options.title: Narrow the branch
options.body: Remove the unrelated cron, 1Password, Discord-test, terminal-test, and asset changes, then review the focused client feature with real behavior proof.

options.title: Review the bundle intentionally
options.body: Keep the extra changes only after the relevant owners explicitly review their compatibility and security implications as independently intended work.

options.title: Replace with a focused PR
options.body: Close this branch and open a clean client-only PR if separating the accumulated changes is safer than editing the current head.

recommendation.title: Narrow the branch
recommendation.body: Remove the unrelated cron, 1Password, Discord-test, terminal-test, and asset changes, then review the focused client feature with real behavior proof.
